name: chat_research
title: Research Chat
description: A human-paced research conversation: ask the cast to dig into a topic, weigh evidence, and answer follow-ups. No coordinator, no consensus, no vote — the chat runs until you end it.

phases.title: Research Chat
phases.purpose: Investigate whatever the human asks in an open conversation: surface what is known, separate strong claims from weak ones, name the uncertainty honestly, and answer follow-up questions directly — without pushing toward a forced conclusion.
